written: What the build at format 58 stored for scripts/pptx-fixtures/connectors.pptx before border. A person set Border Dashed and Border width 4 on 256.2, Opacity 70 then Border Solid and Undo on 256.3, and Join Bevel and Cap Round on 256.4 in design mode. An agent set width, colour, dash, compound and both arrowheads on 256.5 and reset the colour of 256.4. A person duplicated slide 256, then duplicated two slides together in grid view; an agent did both too. Offline, Border Dotted on 256.2 stayed on the device. register and index are the server row; device holds the device entries and the journal entry that build keeps; exported is what that build exports from the server row.
